reference:
The Mallory and Irvine Research Expedition of 1999 aimed to discover evidence of whether George Mallory and Andrew Irvine had been the first to summit Mount Everest in their 1924 attempt. Conrad Anker, as part of this expedition, found George Mallory's body on the North Face of Everest. 

FINDING: Conrad Anker located George Mallory's body during the 1999 Mallory and Irvine Research Expedition.
